arxiv-1806-04667.title: Probing the quantum interference between singly and doubly resonant top-quark production in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1806-04667.creator: ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1806-04667.description: Abstract This Letter presents a normalized differential cross-section measurement in a fiducial phase-space region where interference effects between top-quark pair production and associated production of a single top quark with a W W boson and a b b -quark are significant.

arxiv-2211-10782.title: Let Graph be the Go Board: Gradient-free Node Injection Attack for Graph Neural Networks via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2211-10782.creator: Mingxuan Ju, Yujie Fan, Chuxu Zhang, Yanfang Ye
arxiv-2211-10782.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have drawn significant attentions over the years and been broadly applied to essential applications requiring solid robustness or vigorous security standards, such as product recommendation and user behavior modeling. Under these scenarios, exploiting GNN’s vulnerabilities and further downgrading its performance become extremely incentive for adversaries.

arxiv-2305-02215.title: Exploring Linguistic Properties of Monolingual BERTs with Typological Classification among Languages
arxiv-2305-02215.creator: Elena Sofia Ruzzetti, Federico Ranaldi, Felicia Logozzo, Michele Mastromattei, Leonardo Ranaldi, Fabio Massimo Zanzotto
arxiv-2305-02215.description: Abstract The impressive achievements of transformers force NLP researchers to delve into how these models represent the underlying structure of natural language. In this paper, we propose a novel standpoint to investigate the above issue: using typological similarities among languages to observe how their respective monolingual models encode structural information.

arxiv-2310-06608.title: Gadolinium concentration measurement with an atomic absorption spectrophotometer
arxiv-2310-06608.creator: Ll. Marti, L. Labarga
arxiv-2310-06608.description: Abstract Because gadolinium (Gd) has the highest thermal neutron capture cross section, resulting in an 8 MeV gamma cascade upon capture, it has been proposed for dissolution in water Cherenkov detectors to achieve efficient neutron tagging capabilities. While metallic Gd is insoluble in water, several compounds are very easy to dissolve.

arxiv-2312-16135.title: Large composite fermion effective mass at filling factor 5/2
arxiv-2312-16135.creator: M. Petrescu 1 , Z. Berkson-Korenberg 1 , Sujatha Vijayakrishnan 1 , K. W. West 2 , L. N. Pfeiffer 2 and G. Gervais 1,∗
arxiv-2312-16135.description: Abstract The 5/2 fractional quantum Hall effect in the second Landau level of extremely clean two-dimensional electron gases has attracted much attention due to its topological order predicted to host quasiparticles that obey non-Abelian quantum statistics and could serve as a basis for fault-tolerant quantum computations.

arxiv-2406-03124.title: Taylor-Fourier approximation
arxiv-2406-03124.creator: M.P. Calvo, J. Makazaga, A. Murua
arxiv-2406-03124.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce an algorithm that provides approximate solutions to semi-linear ordinary differential equations with highly oscillatory solutions, which, after an appropriate change of variables, can be rewritten as non-autonomous systems with a ( 2 ​ π / ω ) (2\pi/\omega) -periodic dependence on t t .

arxiv-2409-02238.title: Internal Representations in Spiking Neural Networks, criticality and the Renormalization Group
arxiv-2409-02238.creator: João Henrique de Sant’Ana, Nestor Caticha
arxiv-2409-02238.description: Abstract Optimal information processing in peripheral sensory systems has been associated in several examples to the signature of a critical or near critical state. Furthermore, cortical systems have also been described to be in a critical state in both wake and anesthetized experimental models, both in vitro and in vivo .

arxiv-2507-13868.title: When Seeing Overrides Knowing: Disentangling Knowledge Conflicts in Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2507-13868.creator: Francesco Ortu, Zhijing Jin, Diego Doimo, Alberto Cazzaniga, [10px] University of Trieste AREA Science Park
arxiv-2507-13868.description: Abstract Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly leverage diverse knowledge sources to address complex tasks, often encountering conflicts between their internal parametric knowledge and external information. Knowledge conflicts can result in hallucinations and unreliable responses, but the mechanisms governing such interactions remain unknown.

arxiv-2509-01010.title: A Robust Numerical Method for Solving Trigonometric Equations in Robotic Kinematics su.298@osu.edu
arxiv-2509-01010.creator: Haijun Su (su.298@osu.edu)
arxiv-2509-01010.description: Abstract This paper presents a robust numerical method for solving systems of trigonometric equations commonly encountered in robotic kinematics. Our approach employs polynomial substitution techniques combined with eigenvalue decomposition to handle singular matrices and edge cases effectively. The method demonstrates superior numerical stability compared to traditional approaches and has been implemented as an open-source Python package.

arxiv-2601-20320.title: Confidence intervals for maximum unseen probabilities, with application to sequential sampling design
arxiv-2601-20320.creator: Alessandro Colombi
arxiv-2601-20320.description: Abstract Discovery problems often require deciding whether additional sampling is needed to detect all categories whose prevalence exceeds a prespecified threshold. We study this question under a Bernoulli product (incidence) model, where categories are observed only through presence–absence across sampling units. Our inferential target is the maximum unseen probability , the largest prevalence among categories not yet observed.

arxiv-2602-07210.title: Strengthenings of Mazur’s Conjecture for Higher Heegner Points
arxiv-2602-07210.creator: Xiaoyu Zhang
arxiv-2602-07210.description: Abstract . We establish quantitative strengthenings of Mazur’s conjecture regarding the non-torsion property of higher Heegner points on modular and Shimura curves, confirming both a vertical version for sufficiently large powers n n and a horizontal version for primes p ≫ 1 p\gg 1 .

openalex-w2789263551.title: Long-Term Safety of In Utero Exposure to Anti-TNFα Drugs for the Treatment of Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Results from the Multicenter European TEDDY Study
openalex-w2789263551.creator: María Chaparro, Annelies Verreth, Triana Lobatón, Elisa Gravito‐Soares, Mette Julsgaard, Edoardo Vincenzo Savarino, Fernando Magro, Avni I Biron, Pilar López Serrano, María José Casanova, Macarena Gompertz, Sofia Vítor
openalex-w2789263551.source: OpenAlex / The American Journal of Gastroenterology
openalex-w2789263551.description: OBJECTIVES: The long-term safety of exposure to anti-tumor necrosis factor (anti-TNFα) drugs during pregnancy has received little attention. We aimed to compare the relative risk of severe infections in children of mothers with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) who were exposed...

plos-pone-0000725.title: Cellular Immune Responses Induced with Dose-Sparing Intradermal Administration of HIV Vaccine to HIV-Uninfected Volunteers in the ANRS VAC16 Trial
plos-pone-0000725.creator: Odile Launay, Christine Durier, Corinne Desaint et al.
plos-pone-0000725.description: PLOS ONE research article. The objective was to compare the safety and cellular immunogenicity of intradermal versus intramuscular immunization with an HIV-lipopeptide candidate vaccine (LIPO-4) in healthy volunteers. A randomized, open-label trial with 24 weeks of follow-up was conducted in France at six

pmc-10601207.title: Silencing of CD147 inhibits cell proliferation, migration, invasion, lipid metabolism dysregulation and promotes apoptosis in lung adenocarcinoma via blocking the Rap1 signaling pathway
pmc-10601207.creator: Ning Zhang, Zhouzhong Liu, Xuwang Lai, Shubin Liu, Yuli Wang
pmc-10601207.description: ObjectiveCD147 is an important glycoprotein that participates in the progression of diverse cancers. This study aims to explore the specific function of CD147 in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and to reveal related downstream molecular mechanisms.MethodsFollowed by silencing of CD147, the viability, migration, invasion, and apoptosis of LUAD cells were measured by CCK8, wound healing, transwell assay, and flow cytometer, respectively.

pmc-10605980.title: Effect of presentation rate on auditory processing in Rett syndrome: event-related potential study
pmc-10605980.creator: Daria Kostanian, Anna Rebreikina, Victoria Voinova, Olga Sysoeva
pmc-10605980.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundRett syndrome (RS) is a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by mutations in the MECP2 gene. Patients with RS have severe motor abnormalities and are often unable to walk, use hands and speak. The preservation of perceptual and cognitive functions is hard to assess, while clinicians and care-givers point out that these patients need more time to process information than typically developing peers.

pmc-11389555.title: Helicobacter pylori seropositivity associates with hyperglycemia, but not obesity, in Danish children and adolescents
pmc-11389555.creator: Sigri Kløve, Sara E. Stinson, Fie O. Romme, Julia Butt, Katrine B. Graversen, Morten A. V. Lund, Cilius E. Fonvig, Tim Waterboer, Guillermo I. Perez-Perez, Torben Hansen, Jens-Christian Holm, Sandra B. Andersen
pmc-11389555.description: BackgroundHelicobacter pylori colonizes the human stomach and may affect the inflammatory response, hormone production related to energy regulation, and gastrointestinal microbiota composition. Previous studies have explored a potential association between H. pylori infection and pediatric obesity with varying results. Considering the immunomodulatory effects of early-life infection with H.

pmc-11392054.title: Efficacy and Safety of Robotic Surgery vs. Open Surgery for Hilar Cholangiocarcinoma: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-11392054.creator: Sparsh Dixit, Chanrashekhar Mahakalkar, Shivani Kshirsagar, Akansha Hatewar
pmc-11392054.description: Hilar cholangiocarcinoma, a rare and aggressive bile duct malignancy, presents significant challenges in surgical management. Traditionally treated with open surgery, the emergence of robotic surgery has introduced a new dimension to surgical approaches for this condition. This review aims to systematically compare the efficacy and safety of robotic surgery versus open surgery for hilar cholangiocarcinoma.

pmc-11456420.title: Effects of different treatment measures on the efficacy of diabetic foot ulcers: a network meta-analysis
pmc-11456420.creator: Hong OuYang, Jing Yang, Haiyan Wan, Jiali Huang, Yifan Yin
pmc-11456420.description: IntroductionThrough a network meta-analysis, we compared different treatment measures for patients with diabetic foot ulcers (DFU), assessing their impact on the healing of DFU and ranking them accordingly.MethodsWe searched the PubMed, the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), Embase, the WanFang and the WeiPu database.

pmc-11487255.title: A convolutional attention model for predicting response to chemo-immunotherapy from ultrasound elastography in mouse tumor models
pmc-11487255.creator: Chrysovalantis Voutouri, Demetris Englezos, Constantinos Zamboglou, Iosif Strouthos, Giorgos Papanastasiou, Triantafyllos Stylianopoulos
pmc-11487255.description: BackgroundIn the era of personalized cancer treatment, understanding the intrinsic heterogeneity of tumors is crucial. Despite some patients responding favorably to a particular treatment, others may not benefit, leading to the varied efficacy observed in standard therapies. This study focuses on the prediction of tumor response to chemo-immunotherapy, exploring the potential of tumor mechanics and medical imaging as predictive biomarkers.

pmc-11641732.title: Relationship Between Metabolic Profile, Pain, and Functionality in Patients with Frozen Shoulder: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11641732.creator: Dina Hamed Hamed, Celia Rodríguez-Pérez, Leo Pruimboom, Santiago Navarro-Ledesma, Young-Chang Arai
pmc-11641732.description: Background: Frozen shoulder (FS), or adhesive capsulitis, is a disabling condition characterized by pain and restricted shoulder mobility. Aims: This study investigates the relationship between metabolic biomarkers—liver enzymes and thyroid function—and pain and shoulder functionality in patients with FS. Methods: A total of 32 patients (22 women and 10 men) were included in this cross-sectional study.

pmc-11691908.title: QUALITY OF LIFE IN DEMENTIA CAREGIVERS AFTER USING ONLINE SELF-GUIDED ACCEPTANCE AND COMMITMENT THERAPY
pmc-11691908.creator: Josey Batura, Jacob Gossner, Ty Aller, Elizabeth Fauth
pmc-11691908.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAt home family care for individuals with dementia averages 24.4 hours per week, with one in four caregivers providing 40+ hours. Caregivers identify positive experiences but also report burnout. Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) is an empirically validated transdiagnostic approach that aims to increase individuals’ psychological flexibility, or their ability to respond effectively to their internal experiences in the present moment. This study examines the efficacy of a 6-session online, self-guided ACT for Caregivers program.

pmc-12431482.title: 2D to 3D Modification of Chang–Chang Criterion Considering Multiaxial Coupling Effects in Fiber and Inter-Fiber Directions for Continuous Fiber-Reinforced Composites
pmc-12431482.creator: Yingchi Chen, Junhua Guo, Wantao Guo
pmc-12431482.description: Fiber-reinforced composites are widely used in aerospace and other fields due to their excellent specific strength, specific stiffness, and corrosion resistance, and further study of their failure criteria is essential to improve the accuracy and reliability of failure behavior prediction under complex loads.

pmc-12547422.title: ﻿Phylogeny of Phyllozyma (Spiculogloeaceae, Spiculogloeales) with description of four new species from China
pmc-12547422.creator: Zhi-Wen Xi, Chun-Yue Chai, Qiu-Hong Niu, Feng-Li Hui
pmc-12547422.description: ﻿AbstractPhyllozyma, belonging to the family Spiculogloeaceae of the order Spiculogloeales, is a genus of blastoconidia-forming yeasts. Until now, nine Phyllozyma species have been described. During our investigation of yeast diversity in China, several Phyllozyma strains were isolated from the surface of plant leaves collected in Guizhou and Hainan provinces, which represent undescribed taxa.

pmc-12593445.title: Implementation strategies to improve adoption of screening and linkages for non-medical drivers of health in care management using enabling technologies: study protocol for a cluster randomised trial
pmc-12593445.creator: Nicole Cook, Rose Gunn, Brenda M McGrath, Jenna Donovan, Maura Pisciotta, Constance Owens-Jasey, Hannah L Fein, Anna Templeton, Zoe Larson, Rachel Gold
pmc-12593445.description: IntroductionPractice guidelines recommend addressing patient non-medical drivers of health such as access to nutritious food and transportation as part of whole-person care. Emergent electronic health record (EHR)-based tools can enable non-medical needs care coordination, but adoption commonly faces workflow and infrastructure barriers.

pmc-12643690.title: The effect of circulating CD4+ and CD8+ T cells on the prognosis in advanced postoperative pancreatic adenocarcinoma patients who received chemotherapy
pmc-12643690.creator: Qingqing Chang, Hong Fan, Weiwei Si, Jibin Mao
pmc-12643690.description: The purpose of this study was to analyze the impact of circulating immune cells before and after chemotherapy on the prognosis of patients with advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAC). Data were collected from 74 advanced PAC patients with post-chemotherapy, retrieved from the Affiliated Hospital of Nantong University database in Jiangsu.

pmc-13012505.title: Machine learning identifies novel signatures of antifungal drug resistance in Saccharomycotina yeasts
pmc-13012505.creator: Marie-Claire Harrison, David C. Rinker, Abigail L. LaBella, Dana A. Opulente, John F. Wolters, Xiaofan Zhou, Xing-Xing Shen, Marizeth Groenewald, Chris Todd Hittinger, Antonis Rokas
pmc-13012505.description: Antifungal drug resistance is a major challenge in fungal infection management. Numerous genomic changes are known to contribute to acquired drug resistance in clinical isolates of specific pathogens, but whether they broadly explain natural resistance across entire lineages is unknown.

pmc-13197413.title: Heart disease diagnosis and categorization from ECG signals using hybrid Fuzzy-CNN machine optimized by meta-heuristic algorithms
pmc-13197413.creator: Maryam Davani, Mehdi Taghizadeh, Mohammad Amin Pirbonyeh, Jasem Jamali
pmc-13197413.description: Cardiovascular diseases are among the most important causes of global mortality, and their diagnosis is mainly based on ECG signals. The complexity and nonlinearity of these signals have limited the effectiveness of classical machine learning methods. In this study, an optimized hybrid model based on Fuzzy-CNN is presented using meta-heuristic algorithms for classifying 2D images obtained from ECG signals.

pmc-13268793.title: Correlation between novel hematological parameters and assisted pregnancy outcome in frozen-thawed embryo transfer patients
pmc-13268793.creator: Xuefen Cai, Xiaohui Yang, Yiqin Chen, Yuehong Li, Tuxiang Jiang, Yan Sun
pmc-13268793.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe relationship between preimplantation hematological profiles and clinical pregnancy rates following frozen embryo transfer (FET) has not been thoroughly investigated.MethodsA retrospective study was conducted. Participants were categorized into clinical pregnancy (N = 404) and non-pregnancy (N = 313) groups. Novel hematological indices were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression, restricted cubic splines (RCS), and weighted quantile sum (WQS) regression to explore the relationship between exposure effects and clinical pregnancy outcomes.
